chain_words.nuance: to make a small, minor adjustment
to make subtle improvements to precision or clarity
to make something better in general
to raise the value or quality noticeably
to change something completely and fundamentally

explanation: These words all describe making a text or work better, from a small adjustment to a complete change.

usage_notes.difference: 'Improve' means making something better in general; 'transform' means changing it completely, so the result is essentially a different thing.
